inputs: Cached v2 baseline and top50 runs; judge-fill child labels; 20 pilot queries.
rule: 1/(c+baseline rank)+1/(c+LLM rank) over the top50; ties keep baseline order; ranks 51-100 unchanged. Equal weights; c is the approved baseline's RRF constant.

success_criteria.ndcg@10_min: baseline nDCG@10 + half of the top50 arm's nDCG@10 gain
